Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Record Class ServerCapabilities

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.workshop.mcp.spec.ServerCapabilities
Record Components:
experimental - non-standard capabilities, keyed by name
logging - non-null when the server can emit notifications/message
completions - non-null when the server answers completion/complete
prompts - prompt support, optionally with listChanged
resources - resource support, optionally with listChanged and subscribe
tools - tool support, optionally with listChanged
extensions - extension declarations, keyed by identifier
public record ServerCapabilities(Map<String,Object> experimental, Capability logging, Capability completions, Capability prompts, Capability resources, Capability tools, Map<String,Object> extensions) extends Record
Represents the capabilities offered by an MCP server.

Revision 2026-07-28 fixes this object at exactly these seven optional slots. Note what is absent: the pre-2026-07-28 top-level tasks slot was dropped, and anything beyond the core protocol — tasks included — is now declared under extensions, keyed by identifier.

resources.subscribe survives even though the resources/subscribe method itself was removed; it now gates the resourceSubscriptions field of subscriptions/listen.

Since:
1.0
